lots.notes: Channel centre line x = 850 + 9*sin(0.009*z) (riverCenter 436); half-width 52 (water where |x-centre|<52); runs z -244..443 (RIVER.zMin/zMax). Water surface y=2.4 (RIVER.waterY), bed y=-2 (bedY), quay/bank level y=8 (bankY). Footprint w = 104 + 2*9 meander envelope. Water mesh 20x150 grid with vertex wave sin(0.24x+0.08z+0.65t)*0.10 + sin(0.39z-0.8t)*0.035; colours deep #315c61 / glint #b7d2c1, fresnel + flow threads (makeRiverWater 13614). Embankment walls both sides: 1.3 thick x 7.8 tall stone (#777b70) segments every 6 units along z, rotated to follow the meander, with 1.9-wide light coping (#d1c7ae) at y 8.02 (13578). Falling in (y <= 2.85 inside water, not on a rail) teleports the squirrel to the nearer bank at centre +/- 57, y 8.18, z clamped -225..425, flash 'SPLASH!' (cooldown 2 s) (recoverRiverFall 14116). No swimming, no boats moving.

inRiverDistrict: x 687..1150, z -244..443. terrainHeight ramps the original hills to bank level 8 via smoothstep over x 687..735, flat 8 beyond, -2 in the channel (terrainHeight 458). Both bank meshes (128x20 grid) use the cobble material over the WHOLE district (makeRiverBanks 13547). Grass overlays: quay_grass_east and quay_grass_west. Player world clamp ends at x = 1146 (RIVER.endX-4, 6765). District group only visible when player.x > 610 (updateRiverDistrict 14142). Start-at-river spawn (780, 8.18, 51), yaw -0.94 (startAtRiver 14169).
lots.style: cobblestone quay ground (riverCobble canvas texture, tint #c4bdab)

lots.notes: Deck/ramps (riverDeckAt 445): |z|<=7.8; x 744..790 ramps 8 -> 15.8; flat 15.8 over x 790..910; ramps down to 8 at x 956. Cobble deck groundPatch (13756). Arches (bridgeArch 13657): 5 at centres x 802,826,850,874,898, each 24 wide, inner radius 9.6, springing y 3.5 (crown 13.1), body y 1..15.5, depth 15.7; 15 voussoir blocks per face, every third (i%3==0) dark #777b70, the rest light #d1c7ae; 4-sided cutwater piers r 2.3/3.0 x 3.6 tall at x 790,814,838,862,886 (scaled z 3.2, rotated 45 deg). Parapets: stone tube r 0.2 at deck+1.1, z +/-7.7, registered as kind 'fence' routes; posts 0.32x1.05x0.3 every 4 units with 4x0.3 colliders. Suspension chains (#4e7c87) through (772,14),(814,34),(850,25),(886,34),(928,14) at z +/-8.7, kind 'wire' routes; vertical hangers r 0.055 to deck+0.7 wherever 790<x<910 (45 samples). 12 lamps at x 752,777,838,862,925,947 on both sides z +/-6.45. Side faces block walking if height < deck-0.55 (riverBlocked 13488). Road approach from x 650 is in roads.json (rd_030..rd_033).
lots.style: five-arch stone bridge with two towers and blue suspension chains (London Tower-Bridge-like)
